title: A MyGo app in the showcase, one file per app named after its slug

kind.description: native: its windows draw MyGo native UI; web: they show a web frontend.

category.description: What kind of app it is, as a schema.org applicationCategory that Google accepts. The app page's structured data names it; leave out when none fits.

url.description: The app's homepage: its website, or its repository when it has none.

repo.description: Its GitHub repository as owner/name, for an open-source app. Leave out for a closed-source one.

summary.description: One line, for cards and search.

description.description: A sentence or two, for the detail drawer.

icon.description: The app icon: its yldm-tech/ai-logo id, or a file in apps/web/public/icons/. Leave out for the letter tile.

provisional.description: The images that stand in until the project gives its own: the owner's GitHub avatar for an icon, GitHub's card of the repository or a card drawn of it for a screenshot. The completing script sets it; the announcement's issue asks the project for them; whoever replaces one drops it from the list.

added.description: When the app joined the showcase, in UTC (e.g. 2026-11-04T12:00:00Z). The showcase can list apps newest first by it.
